run_mae_pretrain_multinode: run multinode MAE pretraining on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_trainer_job: submit a Trainer job to a submitit AutoExecutor with SLURM parameters and GPU allocation
parse_args_submitit: parse command line arguments for MAE pretraining including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
checkpoint_trainer_resume: checkpoint a Trainer to resume MAE pretraining from a saved checkpoint file
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from submitit JobEnvironment including rank, world size, and output directory
